BiblicalUsage: Zereth is a son of Helah, named in the genealogy of Judah. In 1 Chronicles 4:7, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Zereth is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
